meta.name: ecommerce-video-marketing
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者必备！当您需要为多品类商品策划抖音、小红书等平台的带货视频时，一键生成包含痛点切入、产品展示与专业镜头设计的6阶段高质量视频脚本，轻松打造高转化营销内容，大幅提升品牌销量。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把商品卖点生成带镜头设计的带货视频脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为多品类商品快速产出高转化带货视频脚本
copy.tagline_en: Turn product selling points into video scripts with shot design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce high-converting product video scripts

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 6 阶段流程为你的商品写带货视频脚本：包含痛点切入、产品展示、痛点解决三段，并给出镜头类型、运镜方式和后期（字幕、音乐、音效）建议。
howto.when: 当你需要为商品创作营销视频脚本，或需要电商视频营销专业指导时触发；宠物用品、智能家居、美妆护肤等品类可套用对应模板。

say.text: 帮我给这款自动喂食器写一个 30 秒的抖音带货脚本
say.note: 会先问商品、人群、风格和时长

say.text: 这款护肤品要投小红书，给我 30 秒脚本加镜头设计
say.note: 会给出镜头类型和运镜方式

say.text: 按这几张智能厨电商品图提炼核心卖点，再写 60 秒脚本

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes e-commerce video scripts for your product via a 6-stage flow: pain-point hook, product demo, and resolution, plus shot types, camera moves, and post-production (subtitles, music, sound) notes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a marketing video script for a product, or need guidance on e-commerce video marketing; pet, smart-home, and beauty templates are available.

say_en.text: Write a 30-second Douyin script for this automatic pet feeder
say_en.note: It first asks product, audience, style, length

say_en.text: Skincare product for Xiaohongshu: a 30-second script with shot design
say_en.note: Returns shot types and camera moves

say_en.text: Pull selling points from these smart kitchen images, then write a 60s script
